items.title: Germany reportedly allocates €11.6 billion for Ukraine in 2027 budget
items.summary: Deutschlandfunk reported that Germany's approved 2027 federal budget includes €11.6 billion in support for Ukraine. Total federal expenditure is expected to reach approximately €556 billion.

items.title: Russia claims strike on cargo ship in Black Sea
items.summary: Russia's Defence Ministry said it struck a cargo vessel that it alleged was transporting military supplies to Ukraine. The vessel's cargo and the extent of damage have not been independently confirmed.

items.title: Ukraine reportedly seeks further destruction of Crimean Bridge
items.summary: The Telegraph, citing military sources, reported that President Volodymyr Zelensky wants the bridge to be completely destroyed. The reported directive has not been independently confirmed.
